rationale: The response turns the insult into a chest-out defense using specific Nebraska assets (Chimney Rock, Scotts Bluff, Sandhills Scenic Byway, Platte River crane migration, Strategic Air Command & Aerospace Museum, Henry Doorly Zoo, Willa Cather, Nebraska Nice) and frames them as virtues rather than concessions.
quote: Nebraska isn’t a gap between two coasts. It’s the heartland. And a heart isn’t something you drive through. It’s something you feel.
